newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Royal Caribbean raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Royal Caribbean raised.

text.p: -- Dean Witter analyst Paul Mackey said he raised his recommendation on Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd to buy from accumulate.
-- He said he expects the company to earn $2.20 in 1996, before a $0.16 per share gain from the sale of the Song of Norway, which is seven percent above 1995 earnings.
-- Mackey's 1997 forecast is $2.55 per share and 1998 is $3.45 per share.
-- "The driver is ships," Mackey said, referring to the company's scheduled receipt of four new cruise vessels in the near future that will add 7,900 new berths.
-- Increased capacity wil result in a "tremendous increase in revenue line" and will expand the gross profit margin by "spreading ship overhead over larger number of passengers."
-- In early New York Stock Exchange trade, the shares were up 1/4 to 26-7/8.
